title: Saving online is built, and switched off for now
thisBuild: Behind the scenes: signing in with your email and saving your messes online, so they open on your other phone, is built and tested. It stays switched off until the server is set up, so nothing you see has changed.
The sound engine from the last build is the same: it should sound exactly as before.
watch: Play a few loops, save a mess and open it again: does it all work as before?
Open Messes from the menu: it should look exactly like the last build.
limits: There is no Sign in yet. It appears once the server is ready, in the menu and at the top of Messes.
